answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 28521 Country: India Title: My YOUNGER brother is the officer in the bank he is MBA in finance. I am engineer and we live in joint family, our household expences are born by contribution by both. Shall i continue with him or stay away as his income is based on intrest. (1) Can i eat any things offred by him or not. Question: My YOUNGER brother is the officer in the bank he is MBA in finance. I am engineer and we live in joint family, our household expences are born by contribution by both. Shall i continue with him or stay away as his income is based on intrest. (1) Can i eat any things offred by him or not. Answer ID: 28521 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 65/65/M=1432) According to shariah, the job of writing, reading and calculating interest based dealing is unlawful and a cause of curse. The income earned through it is not lawful and pure. If the job and income of your younger brother is of interest, you should avoid eating any thing given by him and convince him to adopt any halal and lawful job. If he feels regret and starts searching any halal and pure means of income by making tauba (repentance), there is no harm in living with him. Also, you should also help him with your precious advices. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
